Wish i kept really detailed feedback + examples more...

But here's what I've felt through using it ALOT. 

1. The first thing that i use agents for is summarization across many plugins and channels. Notion, Email and Slack... I have 3 editor teams, a management team, all communicate on slack and email, and then my docs are in notion. Most important thing for me is being able to summarize all of it. With Fable, and 5.6 its able to realize what's important and summarize it more accurately. Grok doesn't always find, or lead with the important details feels like it lacks "relevance realization". 

2. Additionally, Grok is very likely to not give me a long winded response... I LOVE conciseness... when it's needed... but Grok (Maybe just in grokbot) constantly wants to say things that are so short winded it doesn't convey all the info i need. It assumes I know things and speaks in slang, when it's clearly not a field i have deep expertise in to know the slang. I would need to find examples of this... I can later. 

3. Creating Documents. It's just not as strong as Claude Models at creating google sheets for example. Often times they are unformatted and are missing columns. Also it creates google sheets really slowly. 

4. This one most of all, similar to 1, is writing. It's good at short emails, which are most of the emails i send. But i've struggled alot with emails that are longer that outline specific professional processes. I wish it was able to mimic my style (or others style) a little better, but I haven't found that to work very well either. 

Again, UI of grokbot is goated. Everyone will copy it. 
Not sure if its model or system prompt, but this is my honest feedback on the actual responses. I'm sure you guys will make a ton of improvements.

CURSOR DELEGATE

Use this when the user wants something sent into Cursor and wants only, or mainly, the cloud agent’s response back.

Typical requests include:

“Send this to Cursor.”
“Ask 5.6 Sol.”
“Delegate this.”

PURPOSE

Grokbot is the mailbox. Cursor does the thinking and writing. The user should receive the cloud agent’s message, not a paraphrase.

The scratch repository is:

[redacted repo link]

This private repository gives delegated Grokbot agents a place to write and reply. It is not a product codebase unless the prompt explicitly asks the agent to build something.

The default model is GPT-5.6 Sol (gpt-5.6-sol).

If the user requests “high” or “5.6 Sol high,” set model_params.reasoning to high. Otherwise, still use gpt-5.6-sol and omit extra model parameters unless the user names them.

You are to return the full response from cursor back to the user.
